question: On burned TUM fr2/rpy rotation windows 0, 3, and 6, does rotation-compensated local expansion reduce rotation leakage relative to the raw-flow baseline?
non_goals: No approach or closing-retention PASS without a separately admitted real positive approach role.
No confirmation, Kill Gate B, Replay, Android, human, safety, or product claim.
No algorithm implementation, execution, tuning, implementation lock, activation, claim, output, or failure receipt in this task.

image_decode.input: TUM registered RGB PNG at the exact pair timestamps in the bound geometry pair identity inventory.
image_decode.color_to_gray: Decode to uint8 RGB, then cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY); no resize, crop, enhancement, denoise, or gamma change.

rotation_source.source: TUM source-native mocap pose only; visual homography, IMU, fusion, or tuned rotation is forbidden.
rotation_source.duplicate_timestamp_rule: last text row wins, as frozen by the TUM geometry audit amendment.
rotation_source.pose_at_rgb_timestamp: Translation linear interpolation and unit-quaternion SLERP inside a pose bracket no wider than 0.050 s; no extrapolation.
rotation_source.homography: H_previous_to_current = K times R_current_from_previous times inverse(K).
rotation_source.current_to_previous_warp: cv2.warpPerspective(current_gray, inverse(H_previous_to_current), (640,480), INTER_LINEAR, BORDER_CONSTANT, 0); validity uses INTER_NEAREST and the same inverse H.

raw_and_compensated_paths.raw: Sparse LK from previous_gray to current_gray.
raw_and_compensated_paths.compensated: Sparse LK from previous_gray to current_gray warped into previous coordinates.
raw_and_compensated_paths.support_manager: Exact OBSERVABLE_THREE_FRAME_SUPPORT_MANAGER_R0 design lock; t-1,t,t+1 input, estimate t to t+1 only, first pair without history uses unchanged R1 baseline and stays in the 299-pair denominator.
raw_and_compensated_paths.support_manager_activation: Only in a 3x3 cell where baseline R1 support is below 12 or hull fraction is below 0.10 in either arm.
raw_and_compensated_paths.support_manager_observability: No generator mask or metadata; forward-backward <=1.0 px, full bilinear median-centered 7x7 patch MAE <=20 intensity, geometric field-exit precedence, 4x4 deterministic Shi-Tomasi supplementation, 10 px occlusion exclusion, 5 px duplicate suppression, at most 80 features per 3x3 cell.
raw_and_compensated_paths.lk: Shi-Tomasi per 3x3 cell: max 80, quality 0.01, min distance 5 px, block 7, non-Harris; pyramidal LK window 21x21, max level 3, termination count 30/epsilon 0.01, backward levels 3 to 0 with best finite error <=1.0 px.

local_affine.grid: 3x3 fixed image cells with round-based boundaries.
local_affine.consensus: cv2.estimateAffine2D RANSAC, reprojection threshold 0.75 px/frame, maxIters 2000, confidence 0.99, refineIters 10.
local_affine.fit: On RANSAC consensus, normalized cell-centered design and numpy.linalg.lstsq rcond=None; velocity=(current-previous)/dt.
local_affine.gates: support >=12, convex-hull fraction >=0.10, design condition <=1000, median residual <=0.75 px/frame.
local_affine.expansion: 0.5 times (a_xx + a_yy) after undoing half-cell normalization, unit s^-1.
local_affine.arm_pairing: Only the intersection of raw and compensated evaluable cell indices contributes; no arm-specific deletion or imputation.

forbidden_variation: Any alternative optical flow, pose source, interpolation, homography, warp, feature detector, support manager, local fit, threshold, grid, aggregate, or abstention rule.
Any parameter tuning or candidate selection on TUM, Bonn, Phase A outcome, or pilot scientific scores.

estimand.local_model: Fixed 3x3 image grid; per-cell local affine expansion e = 0.5 * trace(A), in s^-1 after division by pair dt.
estimand.paired_support: A pair contributes only where both raw and compensated arms are evaluable on the same cell support; arm-specific deletion is forbidden.
estimand.pair_rotation_leakage: Median across common evaluable cells of abs(local_expansion_s_inverse).
estimand.score_direction: HIGHER_IS_BETTER; positive means lower leakage after compensation.
estimand.window_score: Median pair_score across evaluable paired records in one frozen window.
estimand.independence_statement: Windows 0, 3, and 6 are repeated canary conditions from one TUM sequence and one independence group; they are not three independent source samples.
estimand.pair_statement: The 897 planned scientific pairs and all 1196 geometry-interface pairs are time-correlated records, not independent scientific samples.

abstention_policy.coverage_denominator: All 299 predeclared candidate pairs in each scientific window.
abstention_policy.below_coverage_gate: NOT_EVALUABLE at WINDOW scope; no replacement window and no pooled rescue.

constraints.description: Each scientific window retains at least 80 percent of its fixed paired denominator.
constraints.rationale: Prevents a directional score from being computed on a selectively surviving minority.
constraints.calibration_source: Phase A R0/R1 used a frozen 0.80 trial pair fraction; geometry canary confirms 299 candidate pairs in each selected window.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Always report exact coverage at 0.70, 0.80, and 0.90 as diagnostics; only 0.80 is the R0 gate and no alternate window may replace a failure.
constraints.revision_policy: No in-place lowering after outcome access; a changed coverage rule requires a new evidence version.

constraints.description: All three frozen scientific windows have a strictly positive median paired leakage reduction.
constraints.rationale: Zero is the natural no-improvement comparator; requiring every preselected rotation window avoids a pooled pair-level rescue while claiming only canary mechanism direction.
constraints.calibration_source: The geometry audit preselected exactly windows 0, 3, and 6 before algorithm access; no real algorithm effect size was used.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report 1-of-3 and 2-of-3 leave-one-window-out direction only as diagnostics; neither can satisfy R0.
constraints.revision_policy: The zero comparator and all-three rule are immutable after algorithm outcome access; later effect-size gates require independent calibration and a new version.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Compare raw-flow and rotation-compensated local expansion on the same support in three preselected burned rotation windows.
experiment_design.resource_budget: Exactly TUM fr2/rpy windows 0, 3, and 6 for scientific scoring; window 4 only for abstention/interface stress; no other source.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop on firewall breach, identity or ancestry failure, confirmation leakage, missing approach role, unjustified threshold, validator dependence, or failed performance qualification.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Materialize the source archive once before claim, share only verified immutable bytes, compare bounded worker schedules, and compute science independently.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Phase A synthetic fixtures support a rotation-compensation mechanism, while TUM geometry-only discovery preselected real rotation-dominant windows without algorithm outcome access.
hypotheses.causal_difference: The compensated arm removes estimated rotational flow before fitting local expansion; the raw baseline uses the same image pairs and common support without that removal.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether the mechanism direction survives a burned real RGB rotation stress canary.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Three fixed TUM fr2/rpy rotation windows with a paired raw-versus-compensated score.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Window median of raw absolute local expansion leakage minus compensated absolute local expansion leakage, in s^-1.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any frozen scientific window has non-positive window score, or required paired coverage is below 0.80.
hypotheses.resource_budget: 897 planned scientific pair records plus 299 non-scoring interface-stress pair records.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not implement or execute while real positive approach role is absent; after authorization, stop the evidence version on any firewall, cache, validator, or performance failure.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It is the smallest real-data counterfactual that tests the rotation-leakage mechanism without claiming closing retention or confirmation.

failure_learning.observation: No RGB algorithm outcome has been accessed; geometry parity establishes interface readiness only, and a real positive approach role is absent.
failure_learning.inference: The rotation question is worth freezing, but a complete algorithm canary cannot be authorized yet.
alternative_explanations: A future directional failure could reflect tracking/support loss rather than an invalid compensation principle.
A directional success on one sequence could be source-specific and would not establish approach retention.

next_hypotheses: A separately admitted real approach source can provide a positive closing-retention role without sharing ancestry with future confirmation.
